description: This file contains platform-specific functions for OpenWrt, handling tasks like root filesystem detection, disk identification, configuration copying, flashing, upgrading, and image checking for different hardware platforms.

methods.name: platform_get_rootfs
methods.description: Detects and outputs the root filesystem device based on kernel command line parameters.

methods.name: platform_get_n821_disk
methods.description: Identifies the disk device for the N821 platform via sysfs.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_helper
methods.description: Copies backup configuration to the mounted device.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Selects and copies configuration based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_do_flash
methods.description: Flashes kernel and root filesystem to the target device based on platform specifics.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs system upgrade by flashing new images depending on the platform.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the upgrade image for supported platforms.
